brief_summary: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Active-controlled, Parallel group, Phase 3 trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Co-administrated HODO-2224-1 and HODO-2224-2 in Patients with Essential Hypertension and Primary Hypercholesterolemia
brief_title: To Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Co-administrated HODO-2224-1 and HODO-2224-2 in Patients With Essential Hypertension and Primary Hypercholesterolemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 19
* Patients with Essential Hypertension and Primary Hypercholesterolemia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with differences between arms greater than 20 mmHg for mean sitSBP or 10 mmHg for mean sitDBP
* Patients with mean sitSBP ≥ 180 mmHg or mean sitDBP ≥ 110 mmHg

official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Active-controlled, Parallel Group, Phase 3 Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Co-administrated HODO-2224-1 and HODO-2224-2 in Patients With Essential Hypertension and Primary Hypercholesterolemia
